contract_findings: Each flattened configured content open owns one observation state and one digest; capture composition retains prior consumers rather than obsolete configured views.
Input completion publication requires observed EOF, successful primary close and terminal cancellation check. Early close, read/progress/shadow/cleanup failures do not publish a capture.
User shadows complete before capture construction and consumers. Size inconsistency remains a checked IOException; repeated consumers run in declaration order and fail fast without retry or rollback.
OwnedInputStream retains failed owner-initiated close evidence, preventing a later monitor close from publishing false successful completion.
Provider metadata sample time is distinct from provider modification time; no automatic after-read metadata query or atomic source-stability claim is made.

Complete raw references remain bound by source/coverage caller attestations and exact known-size validation. Optional structures reuse the existing manifest/precompute key and do not add a parser or payload store.
MFileCapture is detached and immutable; it retains metadata/reference objects without a live provider owner.
